remarks: Park-backing and custom built by Art Homes! Welcome to this stunning home in the growing community of Mattson. Backing onto a brand-new park, this thoughtfully designed home features a main floor bedroom and full bathroom, ideal for guests or family. The open-concept layout showcases a modern kitchen with extended cabinetry for added storage, overlooking the dining and living areas, all complemented by a breathtaking open-to-below design. Upstairs offers three spacious bedrooms, a huge bonus room, convenient laundry room, and a luxurious primary bedroom with a spa-inspired ensuite and oversized walk-in closet. Built with exceptional craftsmanship and quality finishes throughout, this home is close to parks, walking trails, schools, shopping, and future amenities. Photos are representative. (id:67522)
